item.title: dotnet: Get Your .NET MAUI App Ready for Xcode 27
item.description:
Microsoft published guidance for preparing existing .NET MAUI apps for Xcode 27. The post explains scene lifecycle changes and the manual migration steps needed to update apps.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
item.description:
GitHub updated CodeQL support for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4 because Apple removed Intel (x86_64) code from some system binaries and libraries that CodeQL uses for build tracing. This affects how CodeQL traces builds on these platforms.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image generally available
item.description:
GitHub Actions now offers the Xcode 27 runner image as generally available for building and testing Apple apps. It was previously in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub
